@backToRequest.description: Button that closes the appearance settings.

@cancelRequest.description: Accessible name of the Cancel button.

@save.description: Files the request under a name.

saveUpdateTooltip: Update the saved copy of this request, or rename it

@tabBody.description: Request detail tab and response tab: the payload.

@tabPreview.description: Response tab: image or HTML preview.

saveResponseTooltip: Save response body to a file
responseBodyPlaceholder: Send a request to see its response

@contextClose.description: Tab right-click menu: close the tab.

@language.description: Appearance field that picks the UI language.

@followSystem.description: Language option that defers to the operating system.

@trayShow.description: System tray menu item that brings the window back.

@trayQuit.description: System tray menu item that exits the app.

appearanceNote: Changes apply immediately and are kept on this device.

@backToRequestTooltip.description: Tooltip of the button that leaves the Appearance panel.

@theme.description: Appearance field: light, dark or following the system.

@tabColor.description: Appearance field: the colour of the picked tab.

@requestTabsField.description: Appearance field: how the request tabs are laid out.

requestTabsFieldHint: Multi-line wraps the tabs onto as many rows as they need, showing method above name. Single line keeps one compact row that scrolls sideways, with the close button inside each tab.

@requestTabsFieldHint.description: Description of the Request tabs field.

@backgroundMode.description: Appearance field: solid colour or an image.

backgroundImageHint: Image is cropped to cover the window; solid color remains available as a fallback.

@chooseImage.description: Accessible name of the button that picks a background picture.

chooseImageTooltip: Choose a PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, or BMP background

@choose.description: Button text beside an upload icon.

@clearBackground.description: Accessible name of the button that drops the background picture.

@clear.description: Button text beside a cancel icon.

@notSelected.description: Shown where a path would be, while none is picked.

@closeWindowAction.description: Appearance field: what the close button does.

closeToTrayLabel: Minimize to the system tray instead of quitting
closeToTrayHint: With this on, the close button hides the window to the tray, and the tray icon brings it back or quits; with it off, closing quits.
saveRequestNote: Kept on this device with its URL, headers, query parameters and credential.

@saveRequestNote.description: Under the Save request dialog heading.

@requestNamePlaceholder.description: Empty name field in the Save dialog.

@fieldGroup.description: Dialog field: which group to file under.

@willSaveToGroup.description: Live preview of where the request will go.

newGroupHint: Type to create a new group; leave blank to use the selected one

@thisRequest.description: Stands in for a name when the request has none.

@savedNameTaken.description: Error on a duplicate saved name.

@noFileChosen.description: Shown where a file path would be.

@chooseFile.description: Accessible name of the file picker button.

chooseFileFieldTooltip: Choose the file sent as this field

@sentAsContentType.description: Under the raw body editor: the Content-Type that will be sent.

noRequestBody: No request body will be sent.

@emptyBody.description: Shown beside the body mode when none is chosen.

@rawBodyJSON.description: Field label over a raw body, per kind; the others match.

fileUploadNote: Also sent with form-data requests saved before rows had a kind.

filenameMimeNote: The filename and MIME type are sent automatically.

chooseDestinationFirst: Choose a download destination before sending.

@noResponseYet.description: Metadata tab before a request runs.

@requestCanceled.description: Shown when the reader stops a request.

htmlPreviewUnavailable: HTML preview is unavailable in this window.

sendToSeePreview: Send a request to see a visual preview.

@imagePreviewUnavailable.description: Preview tab when the image is gone.

@addHeader.description: Accessible name of the plus button.

@enableHeader.description: Accessible name of a header row's checkbox.

@deleteHeader.description: Accessible name of a header row's trash button.

templateValuesNote: Template values support {tokens} and literal text.

@randomLengthHint.description: Placeholder of the pattern field for a random string.

@randomGenerated.description: Placeholder when there is nothing to type.

userAgentNote: Sent as the request User-Agent unless a custom User-Agent header overrides it.
headerRowsNote: Header rows can carry Authorization, Content-Type, cookies, tracing IDs, or any custom header.

@decreaseTimeout.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the minus stepper.

@increaseTimeout.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the plus stepper.

@closeTab.description: Accessible name of a tab's close button.

@deleteSavedRequestButton.description: Accessible name of the trash button beside a saved request.

@deleteNamed.description: Tooltip naming the saved request about to be dropped.

exportHistoryTooltip: Export request groups and records as JSON

importHistoryTooltip: Import request groups and records from JSON

@import.description: Button text beside an upload icon.

@searchHistory.description: Label of the history search field.

@authKeyName.description: Auth field: the name of an API key. The value stays a literal.

@authKeyValue.description: Auth field: the API key itself.

@authAddTo.description: Auth field: whether the key travels as a header or a query row. Options stay Header/Query.

@authModeNone.description: Auth mode label; the stored value is "None".

@authModeApiKey.description: Auth mode label; API key stays English.

@authNoToken.description: Under the Auth fields when a bearer token is missing.

@authBearerSends.description: Header name and scheme stay as the wire format spells them.

@authBasicSends.description: Header name and scheme stay as the wire format spells them.

authApiKeySends: Sends the key as a header row, or as a query row when Query is picked.

authNoCredential: This request sends no credential yet.

@groupUngrouped.description: Group filter: requests with no group.

groupDeleteNote: The group information will be removed. Requests in this group will move to Ungrouped.
groupNameTaken: Another group already uses this name.

@untitled.description: A tab with neither a name nor a URL.

@saveRequestsFailed.description: Global error when requests.json cannot be written.

@saveSettingsFailed.description: Global error when settings.json cannot be written.
